title: HOPE SPEECH DETECTION: A COMPUTATIONAL ANALYSIS OF THE VOICE OF PEACE
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational detection of 'hope speech' (pro-peace and de-escalating content) in the context of the India-Pakistan conflict. While it identifies religious terms as keywords for its classification task and discusses the humanitarian aspects of conflict, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, formal ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning systems within language models.
